text:
Taylor: quick handoff — I'm dropping off for the night, leaving an active issue that's still being mitigated. short summary: KV cache eviction oscillation causing p99 tail latency spikes for embeddings and text-gen. alerts firing intermittently in eu-west and us-central, small subset of customers affected. INC-4721 referenced in alerts.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: INC-4721 — kv-cache-eviction-oscillation — 4 active pages in last 30m.

Sanjay: I'm taking primary for the next 6h (06:30 UTC). Priya pls be secondary; can you monitor customer tickets and take on escalations? :thumbsup:

Priya: on it. I pulled up the runbook — section 3 (prefetch + routing) looks relevant. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction (last updated 2025-02-12)

Taylor: mitigation steps in progress:
- scaled prefetch workers +2 in eu-west (manual scale, will hold until stable)
- enabled conservative routing policy to fallback->quantized-variant for heavy gen paths
- temporarily raised eviction threshold on hot partitions from 60% -> 75% to reduce churn (monitoring only)

Sanjay: noted. action items for primary: watch eviction rate and queue_depth metric, check agent logs for repeated rebalances. I ran the quick check: 
```
# kv metrics quick check
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/query?m=kv_eviction_rate | jq '.'
# expected < 0.05, current ~0.21 in eu-west
```

Priya: customer impact check — Support reported 7 tickets in last 45m, two are priority P1 (customer A, customer D) showing 5-10s stalled responses on batch embeddings. I've opened a private thread with SEs and flagged for mitigation.

Taylor: rollback plan if mitigations worsen: revert eviction threshold, remove routing override, and spin up extra dedicated capacity pool (we have reserved slack for burst). Playbook section 4.2 has commands.

opsbot: autoscaler event: added 2 prefetch-worker instances in eu-west at 2025-03-14T22:04:12Z.

Sanjay: current blockers: we still see periodic rebalances that coincide with the eviction spikes. hypothesis: small traffic bursts + aggressive prefetch eviction loop. Next step: add short-term prefetch backoff (20s) and watch. Priya please watch customer queues and escalate if error rate > 1% for any tenant.

Priya: watching. I've pinned dashboards: kv_eviction_rate, gen_p99_latency, prefetch_retries, tenant_error_rate. will post if anything crosses thresholds.

Taylor: FYI left two crons paused that touch hot partitions: prefetch-retrain and nightly-promote. they were causing compaction pressure during older windows.

Sanjay: ops checklist I'm following:
1) verify autoscaler stabilized (opsbot event confirmed)
2) observe eviction_rate for 30m window
3) if eviction_rate > 0.15 for 30m -> toggle backoff and raise threshold -> notify product + support
4) if tenant_error_rate > 1% or any P1 remains open 20m -> page infra-lead + oncall-manager

Priya: just saw one of the P1 customers report degraded throughput improved after fallback routing applied. will confirm with SE.

Taylor: handoff notes left in incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-4721/notes. key points: primary toggles must be communicated to support before flipping routing. also tracked runbook commands I used in the timeline.

Sanjay: thanks — I'll keep this thread updated. if anything urgent pages me directly. otherwise will post a short summary at end of my shift.

Priya: acknowledged. good handoff. :white_check_mark:
